rules.description: Fund 5-Year Rolling Return Average must exceed Benchmark Average

rules.label: Sharpe Ratio

result.fundName: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth

insights: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth consistently outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 1.93% (15.60% vs 13.66%).
Beat the benchmark in 100.0% of rolling windows — strong consistency for a Equity: Large Cap.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 0.97 vs benchmark 0.69, Sortino 1.30.
Benchmark-like risk shape: beta 0.96, volatility within 2% of the index.
Positive alpha of 5.24% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 1.24).
Drawdown profile is similar to benchmark (-18.91% vs -20.58%).
Rolling return range spans 12.32% to 19.24% (6.92 pp spread) — consistency score 100.
This fund satisfies all three Golden Triangle conditions.
